title: LogisticsRequest
description: payload.kind == 'logistics'. Task payload for multi-stop logistics routing E2 bus consumer (ADR-0043). Published on #tasks.

stops.description: Ordered list of [lat, lon] stops; stops[0] is the depot/start. minItems 2.

return_to_start.description: If true, append the depot at the end to close the loop.

fixed_order.description: If true, do NOT optimize order; sequence stops as given.

reply_to.description: Agent address where the logistics_result is delivered.

constraints.description: Optional reserved constraints; ignored in v1.

vehicles.description: Number of vehicles for multi-vehicle VRP-lite routing.

depots.description: Optional array of [lat, lon] depot coordinates; one per vehicle when provided.

balanced.description: If true, balance workload across vehicles rather than minimizing total cost.

demands.description: Per-stop demand (optional); length should equal stops.

time_windows.description: Optional per-stop [open, close] time windows in seconds, aligned to stops.

service_times.description: Optional per-stop service times in seconds, aligned to stops.
